## Rule

**SOLVED 2026-06-07** (source-read: `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_d9fac9be.py` + corpus 200k):
grid 5-12 x 5-12, **exactly two colors {c0,c1}**: ~20% noise randomly split between them,
then a **solid 3x3 block of c1** stamped at an interior center (rows/cols `randint(2, dim-3)`
= 2..9) and the block **center overwritten to c0**. Output = 1x1 grid = **c0** (the color at
the center of the unique monochrome 8-ring). LIVE implements "argmin over present colors of
max 3x3 window density" — one of many detectors for the same invariant; LIVE = 100% on 200k
(clean class, byte-equal gate is gold).

## Algorithm sketch

```python
# v4 (current best, cost 523):
ringval = conv(input, ring(3x3, hole) x w_pack/8)[windows 1..8]   # (A + 128*occ)/8
# spacing lemma: ringval == va + 128  IFF  window is a solid ring of color va
#   (partial: <= 121 < 128+1; full-mixed: ka+(8-k)b == 8a => k==8, 2-color exchange)
va = max present color;  S = sum of present colors;  vb = S - va   # exactly 2 colors
answer = vb if max(ringval) == va + 128 else va    # block exists by construction
output = onehot(answer) padded to 30x30            # Pad = free output node (#67)
```

## Cost analysis

v4 = 411 memory + 112 params. Anatomy: ringval [1,1,8,8] F32 256 + counts/presf/mula
[1,10,1,1] 3x40 + six scalars ~25 + onehot 10; params = ring kernel [1,10,3,3] 90 + ids 10 +
12 misc. **Floor argument (~520 for any formulation)**: counts alone are NOT separating
(3.52% of 200k have count(c0) >= count(c1)) so a spatial scan is mandatory; any window
statistic must exist as a charged F32 tensor >= [1,1,8,8] = 256 B (centers span 2..9 exactly,
so 64 windows; element count is LAYOUT-INVARIANT — stride/offset decompositions emit the same
64 scalars across several tensors; F16/u8 birth impossible from F32 input through Conv; a BOOL
plane needs a same-size F32 comparison ancestor; runtime-Gather locate-then-detect is §39
dynamic-class); presence needs the
[1,10,1,1] triple (120 B) since va/S require Sign (count-weighted max picks the wrong color,
counterexample {2 x20, 9 x1}); + ~30 B assembly + ~110p kernel/inits. v4 sits at that floor.

**Final-op family enumeration (#68 standard — none can absorb the scan):** the scan feeds
ReduceMax (an aggregation), and output-node families absorb GEOMETRY, not reductions.
| family | verdict |
|---|---|
| Pad placer (#67) | IN USE — pre-pad tensor already minimal (10 B onehot) |
| Conv-with-pads placer (#78) | placer input would be the answer onehot itself; nothing upstream fuses |
| Equal-tail (#67) | needs a [1,1,30,30] answer/sentinel canvas (3,600 B) vs 10 B + free Pad — dead |
| BitwiseAnd LUT (#78) | int-plane machinery for a single one-hot cell — dead |
| signed-margin direct output (decode >0 as the only threshold) | m_c = p_c(1−2e)(v_c−1/2) works logically but costs 182 B of margin assembly vs the 18 B comparison tail — dead |
| contraction-final / Einsum (#68 addendum) | linear; the decision needs Equal+Where — dead |
| params-only single node (#68) | output is input-dependent — dead trivially |

## Don't-do log

- **Global count features alone**: count(c0) >= count(c1) in 7,039/200000 (3.52%) — any
  count-only rule is dead. Margin c1n−c0n reaches −13.
- **c²/64 second-moment kernel**: (A/8)² must equal **B/8**, not B/64 (A²==8B ⟺ A²/64==B/8).
  The /64 version tests A²==B = "≤1 occupied ring cell" — fires all over noise (701/2000).
- **Occupancy+sum WITHOUT the 128-spacing pack** (two separate planes + max-extraction of
  sum/8): mixed full rings produce fractional/fake values that pollute ReduceMax-based
  extraction (e.g. {2,6}-ring sums 16+4k, k=1..7 → fake "colors" 3,4,5). Only the
  exists-semantics max-bound test (v3/v4) survives mixed rings; proven by the exchange lemma.
- **Sum-based fire aggregation** (einsum instead of ReduceMax over masked fires): corpus has
  2/200000 multi-fire pairs (both same ring color) — sums double-count → wrong value.
- **fp16 anything**: spread sweep +31,478 (Cast overhead); planes here are born-F32 (input is
  F32; Conv dtype-uniform), so F16 never gets a foothold. Confirmed twice (2026-05-20 worker
  + this session's enumeration).
- **Counts-from-ring-data**: c1 = (mx−1024)/8 is recoverable from the scan when exb is true,
  but the ANSWER color has no spatial structure (pure noise + 1 center cell) — no ring
  statistic carries it, and the exb-false branch needs va regardless. The global per-color
  reduce + Sign + id-extract (120 B) is information-theoretically mandatory. Confirmed x3
  routes (2026-06-07 ping-2 round).
- **Inverted-pack dual test**: w'(c)=138−c bounds solid-MIN-color rings (real lemma, exchange
  argument symmetric) — but yields an existence bit, not the other color's VALUE; the
  [2,10,3,3] two-channel variant trades −90p for +256 B. Net worse, twice.
- **Kernel split** (1x1 ramp 10p + [1,1,3,3] ring 9p instead of fused [1,10,3,3] 90p):
  re-introduces the 400 B cropped idx plane (v1's shape) — +400 B for −71p. The fused
  channel-weighted kernel IS the compression.
- **Opset-18 Pad-axes shave**: pads[4]+axes[2] = 6p beats pads[8] = 8p (probed working), BUT
  opset 18 removes ReduceMax's axes-ATTR form → +3p of axes inits across the two ReduceMax
  nodes. Net +1. Stay at opset 16.
- **Presence-triple alternatives** (Min(ids, 9·counts), Relu-clamp chains, symmetric-function
  vb via Σc²·pres): all land at the same 120 B / 3 tensors or worse — Sign triple is minimal.
- **Residual tail (accepted, do not "fix")**: a noise-made solid ring of c0 while c0 is the
  max color would flip the answer (v1..v4 all share an equivalent class; LIVE's density
  argmin TIES on it too). Measured **0/200000**; P ≈ 1e-7/draw. Any guard costs >100 B for
  zero measured benefit.
